pr_title: Proposed fix for: some ST boards fail to build `samples/sensor/sensor_shell`
pr_comments: The sample is failing for `stm32h735g_disco` as well in #72909, the driver patch here will sorta bury the issue as they will pass build-only test. Might have to remove all `vbat` nodes that shouldn't be enabled in the first place?
@erwango I've removed the commit that modifies the DT of `nucleo_h753zi` as there's probably more boards that should be updated and created #72914 for that

issue_context.title: some ST boards fail to build `samples/sensor/sensor_shell`

**Describe the bug**
`nucleo_h753zi` fails to build `samples/sensor/sensor_shell`, because the `vbat` driver depends on `adc3`, but `adc3` is not enabled in the devicetree.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. `west build -b nucleo_h753zi -p auto zephyr/samples/sensor/sensor_shell`

**Expected behavior**
Sample should compile

**Impact**
This is failing in #72833

review_comments:
I can do that but then there will be no difference between 'adc driver init failure' vs 'adc node not enabled in devicetree'

cc @erwango, any preference?
Is it possible if `DT_HAS_ST_STM32_ADC_ENABLED` has been added?
As mentioned in the commit,  that checks if we have at least an adc enabled in the DT, but not necessarily the one used by vbat

> DT_HAS_ST_STM32_ADC_ENABLED

Yes, another adc instance could be enabled, but not the one we need.

> As mentioned in the commit, that checks if we have at least an adc enabled in the DT, but not necessarily the one used by vbat

Fair enough.

> I can do that but then there will be no difference between 'adc driver init failure' vs 'adc node not enabled in devicetree'

Indeed, `'adc node not enabled in devicetree'` can be a tricky one, it's better if we're able to provide a clear error message on this specific issue.
I've seen the other PR indeed. Strange.. Thanks for having had a try anyway
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blame/main/soc/nxp/rw/soc.c#L293 @decsny it looks like it won't work.
